_comment_secrets: This file is checked into source. Do NOT add secrets here. For local dev: put values in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored). For UAT/LIVE: use environment variables (double-underscore convention, e.g. Twilio__AuthToken) or hosting secret stores. Empty string means 'must be supplied at runtime'.

Database._comment: Picks which ConnectionStrings entry to use at startup. Override per environment with Database__UseLive=true for LIVE, false (or unset) for UAT.

Auth._comment_TestMode: QA/staging-only OTP bypass. When Enabled=true, the OTP verify endpoints (phone via Twilio + email/SMS/WhatsApp via OtpService) ALSO accept the literal BypassCode in addition to the real provider check. Default Enabled=false. NEVER set Enabled=true in production. Override in non-prod via env var Auth__TestMode__Enabled=true.

Agents._comment_CommissionPerApprovedLead: Rand paid to an agent per approved SellerLead. Default R10 matches the frontend constant that was the source of truth before the AgentPayouts ledger landed. Override per environment via env var Agents__CommissionPerApprovedLead.

_comment_CommunicationTestMode: DEV/UAT ONLY. Central recipient override for outbound comms via ICommunicationRecipientResolver. When Enabled=true, NON-security emails/SMS/WhatsApp are re-routed to the Override* addresses (masked override logged). Security OTP/login/password-reset recipients are overridden ONLY when OverrideSecurityOtpRecipients=true (default false). All defaults empty/false = production. UAT: CommunicationTestMode__Enabled=true, CommunicationTestMode__OverrideEmailTo=profi384@gmail.com, CommunicationTestMode__OverrideSmsTo=+27XXXXXXXXX, CommunicationTestMode__OverrideWhatsAppTo=+27XXXXXXXXX. NEVER enable in production.
_comment_EmailTestMode: DEPRECATED — superseded by CommunicationTestMode. Retained only as a FALLBACK for OverrideEmailTo when CommunicationTestMode:OverrideEmailTo is empty (resolver logs a deprecation warning when it falls back). Migrate to CommunicationTestMode__OverrideEmailTo and remove this section.
_comment_Payments_MockCheckout: DEV/UAT ONLY. When MockCheckoutEnabled=true, POST /api/payments/mock/order-success can settle an order WITHOUT Ozow — it runs the SAME paid-transition path as a real webhook (PaymentStatus=Paid, product order=AwaitingSellerAcceptance, seller notified) and never books dispatch (acceptance is still the trigger). Default false. The endpoint returns 404 when false and is HARD-BLOCKED in Production regardless. Toggle in UAT via env var Payments__MockCheckoutEnabled=true. NEVER enable in production.
_comment_OneSignal: Push notifications. Enabled=false (default) registers the Null push transport so missing keys NEVER break booking/payment/notification flows — in-app (REST + SignalR) still works. To turn on push: set Enabled=true and supply AppId + RestApiKey at runtime via env vars OneSignal__Enabled, OneSignal__AppId, OneSignal__RestApiKey.
_comment_ZansiDispatch: Delivery provider mode. LAUNCH-SAFE DEFAULT: DefaultProvider=InternalEstimate (managed 'ZansiHustle Dispatch' fee) + CourierGuy.Enabled=false, so real Courier Guy pricing is NEVER charged to buyers until its response-shape mappings are validated against a real sandbox response. This config value OVERRIDES any stale DB setting row. To VALIDATE Courier Guy in UAT: set env ZansiDispatch__DefaultProvider=CourierGuy, ZansiDispatch__CourierGuy__Enabled=true, __SandboxMode=true, __BaseUrl=https://api.shiplogic.com, __ApiKey=<sandbox-key> (key never committed/logged). FallbackToInternalEstimate=true means a courier failure silently shows the generic internal estimate (never Courier Guy branding).

ZansiDispatch._comment_CourierGuy_AllowShipmentBooking: KILL SWITCH for CREATING NEW courier bookings only (POST /shipments charges the account) — create-from-quote, auto-book, retry-booking. Default false. Does NOT block cancel/status/label of an already-booked shipment, nor internal cancellation of unbooked ones (those use AllowProviderCancellation / AllowProviderStatusRefresh, default true). SandboxMode does NOT prevent charges — use a sandbox/test ApiKey. Toggle via ZansiDispatch__CourierGuy__AllowShipmentBooking=true.
ZansiDispatch._comment_CourierGuy_AllowProviderCancell: Whether ops can CANCEL an already-booked courier shipment via the provider. Default true (cancelling is risk-reducing — never get stuck with a booked shipment you can't cancel). Independent of AllowShipmentBooking. Set false to freeze all provider cancellation (a booked cancel is then parked as NeedsAttention).
ZansiDispatch._comment_CourierGuy_AllowProviderStatusR: Whether the platform may poll the provider for live status/tracking. Default true (non-billable, never creates a booking). Independent of AllowShipmentBooking.
ZansiDispatch._comment_CourierGuy_AutoBookAfterSellerA: When true, the backend auto-books the courier right after the seller accepts a paid order (no manual Swagger call). Default false. Still gated by AllowShipmentBooking — auto-book NEVER bypasses the kill switch, and a failed auto-book marks the shipment NeedsAttention without failing the accept. Toggle via ZansiDispatch__CourierGuy__AutoBookAfterSellerAcceptance=true.
ZansiDispatch._comment_CourierGuy_Curation: Checkout quote CURATION (allowed codes / preferred / outlier / advanced / high-fee warning) is OPERATIONAL POLICY and is now DB-managed in ZansiDispatchSettings (Dispatch.Checkout.* keys), editable from the ZansiDispatch portal — NOT here. Env/appsettings keeps only credentials, base URL, and hard safety switches.

_comment_DispatchDebug: UAT/dev only. Set DispatchDebug__Enabled=true to emit [DispatchQuoteDebug] logs for the delivery-quote flow (incoming request, provider request/response, mapped response), keyed by X-Correlation-Id. Keep false in production. Sensitive fields are redacted regardless.

Storage._comment_R2_PublicBaseUrl: MUST be set in UAT/LIVE via environment variable Storage__R2__PublicBaseUrl. Format: https://pub-{hash}.r2.dev (Cloudflare R2 auto-provisioned public dev URL) or https://{your-cdn-domain} (custom domain on the public bucket). When unset, FinalizeAsync returns a 7-day signed R2 URL whose signature changes on every read, defeating the mobile image cache and producing slow/flickering grids.
Storage._comment_R2_credentials: AccountId / Endpoint / AccessKey / SecretKey MUST be supplied at runtime via env vars (Storage__R2__AccountId, Storage__R2__Endpoint, Storage__R2__AccessKey, Storage__R2__SecretKey) or user-secrets. Empty here means 'must be supplied at runtime' — startup will throw if any are still empty when the API tries to resolve IMediaStorageService.
